limitations: The audit uses stratified E68 parameter profiles rather than every duplicated policy record.
Paths use independent Bernoulli request outcomes and the original recursive E70 checkpoint grids; traffic correlation and E75 phase/rounding alternatives remain unmodeled.
Certification simulates one aggregate stream with dimension count represented through alpha allocation, matching E68-E70 rather than modeling heterogeneous per-dimension rates.
Service cost is fixed, running jobs are nonpreemptive, and the pending queue holds only the latest look.
Monte Carlo intervals quantify simulation uncertainty, not uncertainty in the underlying measured-service model.
model: Replay realized Bernoulli sufficient-statistic paths at the original recursive E70 checkpoints. Certification jointly samples state errors, conditional mistake recall, and conditional false alarms. Drift samples random eligible labels and post-change outcomes. FIFO evaluates every look; latest-pending coalescing evaluates only its deterministic outcome-independent subset.

validation.outcome_independent_selection: Queue selection depends only on checkpoint arrivals, service cost, and worker availability.
